Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Declares Dividend July 29, 2026 HAMILTON, Bermuda, July 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Teekay Tankers Ltd. ( Teekay Tankers or the Company ) (NYSE: TNK) today reported the Company’s results for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and announced that its Board of Directors has declared its fixed quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The cash dividend is payable on August 21, 2026 to all shareholders of record as at August 10, 2026. The full earnings release and Teekay Group’s earnings presentation are available on the Company’s website here . About Teekay Tankers Teekay Tankers has a fleet of 34 double-hull tankers (including 14 Suezmax tankers, 18 Aframax / LR2 tankers, and two Suezmax tanker newbuildings), and also has three time chartered-in oil tankers. Teekay Tankers’ vessels are typically employed through a mix of spot tanker market trading and short- or medium-term fixed-rate time charter contracts. In addition, Teekay Tankers manages and operates vessels for the Australian Government and Australian energy companies as part of the marine services provided by the Company and owns a ship-to-ship transfer business that performs full service lightering and lightering support operations in the U.S. Gulf and Caribbean. Teekay Tankers was formed in December 2007 by Teekay Corporation Ltd.
